allowed_use: The fraction of the published DRAM read capacity a finite read stream achieves, given the CTA grid, the bytes each CTA streams, and the threads per CTA. Dividing compulsory DRAM read bytes by capacity times this fraction gives a completion bound for a weight-streaming launch. v2 adds the request-depth axis that v1 pins to a single value.

derived_model.fraction_above_unity_note: One cell measures 1.01337, marginally above the published capacity; the capacity is the ceiling, so a consumer clamps at 1.0 while the raw value is kept here.

forbidden_use: A production operator duration, a per-shape correction, a steady-state ceiling, or extrapolation outside the measured grid, per-CTA length or request-depth domain. Reading one depth's surface for a launch at another depth is out of domain.

independent_cross_check.statement: Run at the deployed kernel's own threads per CTA, the probe reproduces the achieved weight-read rate of all thirteen deployed C500 M=1 GEMV projections to a median of 0.971, range 0.874 to 1.005. At a fixed 128 threads it collapses to 0.660 on the grid-80 block-512 cell.

provenance.per_depth_provenance: Each depth carries its own source_commit, source and snapshot SHA256, the SHA256 of the binary that produced it and of its raw report, and its own production_or_evaluation_duration_consumed. A depth missing any of them is refused.

scope.depth_axis_note: 256 threads per CTA is included because that is the depth the Midlayer launch model emits for C500 decode projections, which is not the depth the deployed b16gemvt kernels use. The two are different facts and the surface has to cover both.
scope.domain_extension_note: The domain is grown to whatever the serving path was refused, re-traced after each extension. Sweep 1 covered 64-76032 CTAs at 8-512 KiB and was refused 651 times on length (512-2068 KiB) and 17 on grid (40). Sweep 2 covered 32 CTAs to 2560 KiB and left 63 length refusals (2560-2582 KiB, all Qwen3-32B TP2) and 17 grid refusals (20-30 CTAs, Qwen3-30B-A3B TP2) against 1639 hits. Sweep 3 covers 16-76032 CTAs at 8-5120 KiB. The axes follow the refusals, never the residuals.

why_this_matters: Forward prices these launches at the full published capacity because C500 had no ramp reference, while the deployed projections achieve 1061 GB/s on a 21 MB projection and only reach 1652 GB/s at 1245 MB.
